answer.rationale: Rollback is prohibited. During peak write load, shifting eligible report/dashboard reads off the primary is the least disruptive available action that can directly reduce primary contention while preserving customer writes. Start with a guarded routing cohort and monitor replication lag, primary write p99, error rate, and settlement-write durability; this depends on current read traffic being a meaningful source of primary load, so verify the archived precedent before committing.
